Name: RPG-Ish Party Pack for Custom Music
Author: LavenderLight
TagLine: A pack of RPG-y music that replaces oodles of vanilla songs.
Description:
> Get it? "Party" pack? Because it's RPG-y songs? Do you get it? Do you get my joke? Do you underst-

Just a collection of songs to replace the vanilla ones if you want to try something new. There's a vast variety here: from SNESy JRPG-like songs to funky groovy music you may hear in a modern game.

How To Install:

1.  Get [Custom Music](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043)﻿.

2.  Put that and this mod's folder in your Mods folder.

3.  Run the game and enjoy the new tunes.
